answer:
I added a page to your Reading log note. You can see it under the Page switch. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks. Your table is unchanged.

- **Cover cards:** each book gets a cover-style card with its title, author, star rating and finish date. The colours come from the title, since there are no real cover images. Newest books come first.
- **Average rating:** a large number with stars. It's about 4.2 across your five books.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart that runs from your first finished book to the current month. It shows the last 12 months at most.
- **Add form (extra):** I also put an "Add a book" form at the bottom. It adds a new row to your table.

The page reads from your table, so cards, average and chart update when you add or edit a row.
